title: Beyond scale and hardware
summary: Solar and battery energy storage systems (BESS) have scaled dramatically since 2015, but demand growth is not necessarily translating into better economics for manufacturers, writes Susan Taylor of S&P Global Energy. Solar manufacturers continue to battle overcapacity after years of capacity growth outpacing demand. While the BESS market remains at an earlier stage of growth, rising competition in cells and hardware suggests it may be heading down a similar path. The post Beyond scale and hardware appeared first on pv magazine Global .
